tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find software products by task or name, with optional filters. Returns compact rows (id, entry price, cost-trap ids, pricing date). Ranking is text relevance only, never commission.

query.title: Query
query.description: What the user wants to do or the product name, in plain words, e.g. 'invoicing for freelancers'. Leave empty to browse.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category name exactly as returned by list_categories, e.g. 'Marketing'. Leave empty for all categories.

max_price_usd_month.title: Max Price Usd Month
max_price_usd_month.description: Highest entry price to include, in US dollars per month. Leave empty for no limit.

free_plan.title: Free Plan
free_plan.description: true to return only products with a confirmed free plan, false to exclude them; leave empty for both.

avoid_cost_traps.title: Avoid Cost Traps
avoid_cost_traps.description: Cost-trap ids to leave out, as shown in the cost_traps field of search results.

has_cost_rules.title: Has Cost Rules
has_cost_rules.description: true to return only products with machine-readable price rules (needed by estimate_cost and cost_at_growth).

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Offset for the next page: 0 for the first page, then the next_cursor value from the previous result.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: The full record for one product: plans, every cost trap with its full evidence sentence, pricing date, unknowns, own hands-on observations in measured (claims, exit-test scope and three-valued facts with dates and review links), price rules if any, and the vendor handoff with affiliate disclosure.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: The product's id, from the id field of a search_products result (e.g. 'toggl').

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2 to 6 products side by side. Every requested id is returned, found or not. With units, adds the cheapest fitting plan's cost where price rules exist.

product_ids.title: Product Ids
product_ids.description: 2 to 6 product ids, each from the id field of a search_products result.

units.title: Units
units.description: Team size or the product's own unit (companies, orders) to price at; leave empty to compare without a cost.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: The evidence behind a product's cost traps and free-plan flag: the exact sentences from our pricing notes, the date they were read and the source. Also returns measured when present: our own hands-on claims, exit test and facts (true, false or not_tested), each with dates and public review evidence; separate from vendor claims.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: The product's id, from the id field of a search_products result (e.g. 'toggl').

cost_trap.title: Cost Trap
cost_trap.description: One cost-trap id from the product's cost_traps field to return only that evidence; leave empty for all.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Cost of each plan at a team size (or companies/orders, per the product's axis) on monthly or annual billing: monthly equivalent, amount billed per period, commitment, minimums, add-ons and usage. Only for products with price rules; says so otherwise. Never guesses between published price steps: returns a range.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: The product's id, from the id field of a search_products result (e.g. 'toggl'). Only products with price rules (has_cost_rules) can be priced.

units.title: Units
units.description: Team size, or the product's own unit (companies, orders) as named in its price rules; a whole number of 1 or more.

plan_id.title: Plan Id
plan_id.description: Plan id from the plans field of get_product to price only that plan; leave empty for every plan.

addons.title: Addons
addons.description: Add-on ids from the product's price rules to include in the cost.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Metered usage per month as {usage_id: quantity}, with ids from the product's price rules, e.g. {'sms': 500}.

include_personal.title: Include Personal
include_personal.description: true to also price plans meant for one person (personal or solo plans); false by default.

tools.name: cost_at_growth
tools.description: Cost as a team grows: the cheapest fitting plan at each size and the points where the best plan changes.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: The product's id, from the id field of a search_products result (e.g. 'toggl'). Only products with price rules (has_cost_rules) can be priced.

points.title: Points
points.description: Team sizes to price, as whole numbers (up to 20 points, each 0 to 1,000,000); leave empty for the default growth steps.

tools.name: check_choice
tools.description: Check a software choice against requirements before buying. requirements (all optional): units, billing ('monthly'|'annual'), plan_id, budget_month {amount, currency}, needs_monthly_billing, max_commitment_months, needs_free_plan, avoid_cost_traps [quote_only, per_seat, usage_metered, renewal_jump, addons_extra, annual_lock], features [text], addons [ids], usage {id: quantity}, service (price only that part of a vendor's ladder, e.g. eor, contractor, contractor_of_record, global_payroll). Each requirement gets fits / does_not_fit / unknown / conflicting / recheck_needed / not_flagged / mentioned, with evidence. Outcome is no_blocking_requirement_found, blocking_requirement_found or insufficient_evidence; unknown never counts as a fit.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: The product's id, from the id field of a search_products result (e.g. 'toggl').

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: The buyer's requirements as an object; every field is optional and listed in the tool description (units, billing, budget_month, needs_free_plan, avoid_cost_traps, features and more).

tools.name: get_task_evidence
tools.description: What we observed when we ran products ourselves. Search by task words, product id or result (passed_in_this_test, partial_in_this_test, failed_in_this_test, not_tested, not_available_on_tested_plan, observation). Each result applies to the product as it was on run_date, on the plan stated; a later version inherits nothing.

query.title: Query
query.description: Task words to search our hands-on test results, e.g. 'export contacts'. Leave empty to list all.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: The product's id, from the id field of a search_products result (e.g. 'toggl'). Leave empty for all products.

result.title: Result
result.description: Only return results with this outcome.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 50 (default 10, to keep the answer small).

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Offset for the next page: 0 for the first page, then the next_cursor value from the previous result.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: true to include the full claim_checks and exit_test blocks of up to 3 sessions (large); default false.

tools.name: build_purchase_dossier
tools.description: Build a purchase file for 1 to 6 candidate products against the same requirements (same fields as check_choice). Returns per candidate the check with evidence, the cheapest fitting plan's cost where computable, our hands-on test results, unknowns and the vendor handoff with affiliate disclosure; a fixed order that never uses commission; a summary_markdown to show the user as is (it starts with the share link and says whether any candidate has a confirmed fit); a share_url; and depends_on facts so the file can be re-checked later. A feature counts as documented only from the vendor's own pages, never as tested by us. When requirements.modules names a setup ([{id, role}], e.g. a help desk plus a phone line), read setup_check for the verdict on the whole setup (its known costs per currency, open items and the budget for the setup as a whole); each candidate's own budget line compares that product alone.

product_ids.title: Product Ids
product_ids.description: 1 to 6 candidate product ids, each from the id field of a search_products result.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: The buyer's requirements, with the same fields as check_choice; add modules [{id, role}] to check a setup of several products together.

question.title: Question
question.description: The buyer's question in their own words, shown at the top of the dossier; optional.

tools.name: recheck_dossier
tools.description: Re-check a purchase file built earlier: pass the whole dossier back. Reports which underlying facts changed (entry price, plans, cost traps, price rules, research status, pricing date) and which conclusions that affects. Never buys, cancels or switches anything.

dossier.title: Dossier
dossier.description: The complete dossier object returned earlier by build_purchase_dossier, passed back unchanged.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Find reader offers and vendor offers on our deal pages (discounts, extra credits, longer trials, conditional pilots). Each row has the evidence and its date, the verification status and the deadline in UTC. Expired offers are left out unless include_expired. Ranking is alphabetical, never by discount size or commission.

query.title: Query
query.description: Product name or words from the offer, e.g. 'annual discount'. Leave empty to list all.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: The product's id, from the id field of a search_products result (e.g. 'toggl'). Leave empty for all products.

offer_type.title: Offer Type
offer_type.description: Only return offers of this type.

confirmed_only.title: Confirmed Only
confirmed_only.description: true to return only offers the vendor confirmed in writing.

include_expired.title: Include Expired
include_expired.description: true to also return offers whose deadline has passed.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: The full record of one offer: type, benefit and its structure, eligibility as recorded (null = the vendor did not say), claim steps, code, limits, evidence with dates, deadline, cost after the offer where known, and the vendor handoff with affiliate disclosure. No offer has been tested at a checkout.

offer_id.title: Offer Id
offer_id.description: The offer's id, from the id field of a search_offers result.

tools.name: check_offer_eligibility
tools.description: Check whether an offer fits a buyer's situation: {customer: new|existing, plan, billing: monthly|annual|biennial}. Returns matches, does_not_match (with reasons) or needs_confirmation (missing information, an unconfirmed offer, or a pilot granted case by case), plus what the vendor did not state. A match is not a checkout guarantee.

offer_id.title: Offer Id
offer_id.description: The offer's id, from the id field of a search_offers result.

situation.title: Situation
situation.description: The buyer's situation as {customer: 'new' or 'existing', plan: plan name, billing: 'monthly', 'annual' or 'biennial'}; missing fields are reported as needing confirmation.

tools.name: compare_offer_costs
tools.description: Compare 1 to 3 offers on the same billing term and period. prices maps offer_id to the monthly price the buyer would pay for that product without the offer (same currency as the vendor). Returns fit and cost per offer: pay today, cost over the period with and without the offer, saving, or why it cannot be calculated (credits, a longer trial, unknown duration).

offer_ids.title: Offer Ids
offer_ids.description: 1 to 3 offer ids, each from the id field of a search_offers result.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: The monthly price the buyer would pay without the offer, as {offer_id: amount}, in the vendor's currency.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Billing term to compare on: 'monthly', 'annual' or 'biennial'.

months.title: Months
months.description: Period to compare over, in months (default 12).

situation.title: Situation
situation.description: Same as check_offer_eligibility: {customer, plan, billing}; optional.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All categories with their product counts.
